title: HRRN 高响应比优先：响应比动态升高，长作业不饥饿
expected_output:
进程(A=到达, S=服务): P1(A=0,S=8), P2(A=1,S=4), P3(A=3,S=9), P4(A=5,S=5)

进程   到达     服务     等待       响应比        周转         带权周转      
P1   0      8      0        1.000      8          1.00      
P2   1      4      3        2.750      11         2.75      
P4   5      5      7        2.400      12         2.40      
P3   3      9      14       2.556      23         2.56      

平均周转 = 13.50, 平均带权周转 = 2.18
响应比 = (等待 + 服务) / 服务 = 1 + 等待/服务
关键: 等待越久响应比越高 -> 长作业等待久了必然被选中 -> 不会饥饿
code:
def hrrn(procs):
    """非抢占：每次调度时算所有已到达进程的响应比，选最高者"""
    ps = [{"pid": p[0], "arrive": p[1], "service": p[2], "done": False} for p in procs]
    now = 0
    out = []
    total = len(ps)
    finished = 0
    while finished < total:
        cand = [p for p in ps if not p["done"] and p["arrive"] <= now]
        if not cand:
            now += 1
            continue
        best = None
        for p in cand:
            wait = now - p["arrive"]
            rr = (wait + p["service"]) / p["service"]
            if best is None or rr > best[0]:
                best = (rr, p)
        rr, p = best
        start = now
        finish = now + p["service"]
        now = finish
        p["done"] = True
        finished += 1
        turnaround = finish - p["arrive"]
        out.append((p["pid"], p["arrive"], p["service"], wait, rr, start, finish,
                    turnaround, turnaround / p["service"]))
    return out


procs = [("P1", 0, 8), ("P2", 1, 4), ("P3", 3, 9), ("P4", 5, 5)]
res = hrrn(procs)

print("进程(A=到达, S=服务): " + ", ".join("%s(A=%d,S=%d)" % (p[0], p[1], p[2]) for p in procs))
print("")
print("%-4s %-6s %-6s %-8s %-10s %-10s %-10s" % ("进程", "到达", "服务", "等待", "响应比", "周转", "带权周转"))
for pid, a, sv, wait, rr, s, f, t, w in res:
    print("%-4s %-6d %-6d %-8d %-10.3f %-10d %-10.2f" % (pid, a, sv, wait, rr, t, w))

avg_t = sum(r[7] for r in res) / len(res)
avg_w = sum(r[8] for r in res) / len(res)
print("")
print("平均周转 = %.2f, 平均带权周转 = %.2f" % (avg_t, avg_w))
print("响应比 = (等待 + 服务) / 服务 = 1 + 等待/服务")
print("关键: 等待越久响应比越高 -> 长作业等待久了必然被选中 -> 不会饥饿")
